intro: The Harborage is a quiet settlement of exiled Draenor natives situated in the northern reaches of the Swamp of Sorrows. While many of their afflicted kin wandering the surrounding bogs have succumbed to madness and primal hostility, the inhabitants here have managed to hold onto their sanity and wits. They live cautiously along the waterline, seeking peace amidst a harsh and unforgiving wilderness.

p: Tucked away against the northern mountains of the Swamp of Sorrows, the Harborage stands in stark contrast to the feral tribes wandering the nearby waters. Constructed of rugged leather shelters and adorned with mysterious hanging crystals, this small encampment provides sanctuary to exiled Draenor survivors who have refused to surrender their minds. Under the guidance of elders like Magtoor, they maintain a fragile, civilized enclave while remaining watchful of the hostile wilderness, native predators, and the feral tribes of their fallen brothers lurking just beyond their perimeter.
